svg.title: Four context optimization techniques address different measured bottlenecks and change different metrics.
svg.desc: Compaction summarizes growing message history and is measured by continuation success. Observation masking replaces verbose tool output with typed references and is measured by re-fetch count. Prompt caching reuses a stable prefix and does not shrink the context window. Decision partitioning splits capabilities by step and is measured by handoff failures. Match the technique to the measured source of pressure; there is no universal savings.

text.font-family: Space Grotesk, IBM Plex Sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: Choose an optimization from the measured pressure

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: Four techniques change different measures — pick from the bottleneck, not habit.
